Job Description: 
 Analytical Mechanics Associates, Inc (AMA) is seeking a part-time intern to support the Flight Dynamics Research Facility at NASA Langley Research Center. The CAD Model Design Intern will support the Entry Systems Modeling project to develop free flight and forced oscillation model design for rapid prototype fabrication. Project activities include but are not limited to, forced oscillation and free flight tests to investigate the dynamic stability of blunt entry vehicles. The models to be tested include variations of geometries. Forced oscillation testing and free flight testing will provide static and dynamic stability data for the geometries tested as well as free flight dynamics which will serve as validation data for trajectory simulation analysis.
 Responsibilities 
 Develop models in in the form of .igs or .stp, as well as the native CAD format used for the design work
 Develop CAD models for oscillation configurations that include location of mounting interface at specified reference points,
 Design geometry to accommodate thermal inset fasteners for accurate and reliable mounting to the balance sting
 Create CAD solid models of free flight wind tunnel models using FDM 3D printing methods or similar.
 Design the models to enable a movable center of gravity
 Requirements 
 Undergraduate or Graduate student with a degree in mechanical or aerospace engineering
 Minimum of 2 years’ experience in developing CAD models or 2 semesters of relevant CAD course

title: Sales Development Engineering Intern
description:
National Instruments (NI) is now the Test & Measurement (T&M) business unit in Emerson's portfolio. 

The Sales Development Engineer (SDE) intern role is designed for engineers who want to develop careers in technical sales, applications engineering, and technical marketing. You will benefit from training programs, including training on T&M products and related technologies, our sales process, public speaking and on our customers and markets they serve. Come join our team!

We're looking for engineers who thrive in teams and enjoy time spent with customers discussing complex engineering problems! Applicants will demonstrate resilience and a passion to excel. The successful applicant will demonstrate confidence in sharing new insights and strive to keep updated with market developments, competitors, customer demand, and new product lines to develop their technical competence, customer understanding, and soft skills.

title: Field Device Management Sales Enablement Intern
description:
Emerson is seeking a Sales Enablement and Business Development Intern to join our Reliability Solutions team in the Austin or Round Rock, Texas area. This opportunity is designed for a rising junior or senior who is interested in learning how intelligent field devices, software, and control systems help industrial customers improve plant reliability.


In this role, you will build an understanding of Emerson’s instrumentation, valve, actuator, device-management, and control-system technologies. You will explore how connected technologies support predictive monitoring and help customers make informed maintenance and operational decisions. You will also contribute to customer demonstrations, sales resources, training materials, and technical documentation.

title: Software Product Management Intern
description: If you are a Product Management Intern looking for an opportunity to grow your career, Emerson Test & Measurement (T&M) offers hands-on experience where you will work alongside experienced product managers, engineers, and business professionals to help shape software products that solve meaningful customer challenges. In this role, you will gain exposure to product strategy, customer discovery, market analysis, product development, and product launches while contributing to projects that create value for customers and support business objectives. This internship provides an opportunity to develop product management skills, explore innovative technologies including data and AI-driven solutions, and build a strong foundation for a future career in product management.
